shortDescription: Santos Ltd. Chief Executive Officer Kevin Gallagher said Australia needs gas regulations that encourage investment in new assets to avoid a domestic shortfall and keep global markets supplied, according to Bloomberg.Santos is one of Australia’s top natural gas exporters.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Santos CEO Calls for Gas Rules to Spur Investment in Australia
